Definition: a Beriite (collectively) or descendants of Beriah
BiblicalUsage: Beriyiy is the word for a Beriite, and it shows up only once, in Numbers 26:44.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Beriyiy earns its place, because God put it in the text for a reason.
